onboarding.title: Welcome to NiniApp!
onboarding.subtitle: NiniApp revolves around your group of friends. To get started, create a group or join an existing one.
onboarding.createGroupHint: Pick a name and share the ID and password with your friends. You'll be the admin.
onboarding.joinGroupHint: You need the group ID and its access password.
onboarding.createdShare: Share these details with your friends so they can join:

group.name: Group name
group.leaveMessage: All your data in this group (votes, contributions and seats) will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
group.chooseSuccessor: You are the admin. Choose who inherits the role:

events.invalidDates: Invalid dates (end must be after start)
events.driverCarsHint: Select the group drivers' cars available for this event.

events.lateChangeMessage: Changing your vote now will penalize your commitment score. Change it anyway?
events.validateHint: Mark who actually came among those who said YES. Marking "No-show" penalizes their commitment.
events.seatHint: Only YES voters can take a seat
events.deleteMessage: The event and all its votes will be deleted.

extras.title: Extra features
extras.subtitle: Three utilities with no utility whatsoever. You're welcome.
extras.ifaeDesc: Calculates the straight-line distance from where you are to the Institute for High Energy Physics.
extras.ifaeResultHint: as the crow flies to IFAE
extras.ifaePrivacy: Your location is used on this device only; it is never stored or sent to any server.

extras.ifaeError: Could not get your location. Try again.
extras.ifaeUnavailable: This build of the app does not include the location module yet; reinstall the development build.
extras.pantoDesc: The pantograph is the articulated mechanism mounted on the roof of electric trains that collects current from the catenary. It keeps a constant contact pressure against the contact wire, adapting to height variations at any speed.
